hypothesis_decision.reason: The predeclared success criterion was met on one of two preidentified A failures: qualified B submitted an eligible program and independently Official-passed meshio. Frontier reduction alone was not counted; op-test remained a failure.

subsequent_negative_control.updated_conclusion: A second no-replay strong-Agent session also Official-passed meshio. The observed A-then-B gain is therefore not unique to replay and is matched by A-then-A2 on the complete opportunity set.

claim_boundary.supported: On this fixed falsification screen, same-session clean-replay feedback repaired one terminal deployment failure left by strong free search and increased the observed A-then-B Official success count from 10 to 11.
claim_boundary.not_supported: Two repair opportunities are insufficient to claim a stable effect size, SOTA, broad generalization, or superiority to Repo2Run and Codex.
claim_boundary.required_next_experiment: Freeze a larger bad-case cohort selected from baseline failures without inspecting B outcomes, then compare strong free search and qualified replay repair on every eligible failure under independent Official evaluation.

quality_limit: Official Pass is the primary benchmark endpoint. Full deployment completeness and path quality must be measured separately because the successful meshio program uses a legacy VTK artifact to satisfy the static import objective.
safeguard_policy: This result adds no hash, frozen contract, or software gate. It records outcomes under the pre-existing protocol.
